items.title: Meaning of 'Rescue'
items.explanation: The word 'rescue' means to save someone from danger or trouble.

items.title: Role of the Kotwal
items.explanation: In the story, the policeman is called the kotwal. He runs to the house when he hears his name being called and helps solve problems by catching thieves.

items.title: Problem and Solution
items.explanation: The problem was a thief trying to get into the house. The solution involved the kotwal running to the house, finding the thief, and taking him away.
